description: A source-backed synthesis of ministry focused on Christ, enabled by Christ, and exercised as faithful stewardship.
title: Christ-Centered Ministry

description: A source-backed synthesis of Christ as the eternal Word made flesh, God with us, and the suffering Messiah who bears iniquity.
title: Christ

description: A source-backed synthesis of the church as one body in Christ, gifted for edification, and gathered in his name with his presence.
title: Church

description: A source-backed synthesis of covenant as God-initiated relationship sealed by promise, obligation, and Christ as mediator of the new covenant.
title: Covenant

description: A source-backed synthesis of creation as God's free, ordered work by word and Spirit, establishing his ownership and humanity in his image.
title: Creation

description: A source-backed synthesis of discipleship as following Christ through self-denial, cross-bearing, and counted cost.
title: Discipleship

description: A source-backed synthesis of faith as trust in Gods promise and in Christ, the means of justification and the principle of the life that pleases God.
title: Faith

description: A source-backed synthesis of holiness as conformity to the holy God who calls and sanctifies his people through truth.
title: Holiness

description: A source-backed synthesis of the Holy Spirit as the promised Comforter who indwells, convicts, guides into truth, and empowers the church.
title: Holy Spirit

description: A source-backed synthesis of justice as Gods righteous requirement to do justly, love mercy, and defend the oppressed.
title: Justice

description: A source-backed synthesis of pastoral ministry as qualified oversight and feeding of Christ's flock for the church's edification.
title: Pastoral Ministry

description: A source-backed synthesis of prayer as humble approach to the Father, taught by Christ, helped by the Spirit, and perfected in Christ's intercession.
title: Prayer

description: A source-backed synthesis of prophecy as Gods word spoken through holy messengers, tested against false prophecy, and used for church edification.
title: Prophecy

description: A source-backed synthesis of redemption as price-paid deliverance through Christ, foundational for belonging to God and freedom from sin.
title: Redemption

description: A source-backed synthesis of salvation as Gods free grace in Christ, received by faith and not by works of the law.
title: Salvation

description: A source-backed synthesis of worship as Spirit-and-truth approach to the Father, expressed in praise, sanctuary service, and accepted offering.
title: Worship

description: A developing synthesis of Christ's call, enablement, and expectation of faithfulness in ministry.
title: 1 Timothy 1:12

description: A source-backed answer centered on Christ's worth, strength, and entrusting of ministry to faithful stewards.
title: What Sustains Christian Ministry?

description: Summary and evaluation of a personal devotional on Christ-centered, Christ-enabled, faithful ministry.
title: Devotional on 1 Timothy 1:12
